decisions.1: Release scope: "Adopt the recommended blocking set (recommended)". Blocking set: API-SAME-HOST-1 (+1 MiB WebSocket frame limit), DESKTOP-DATA-OWN-1, DESKTOP-DATA-OWN-2, DESKTOP-GUARDS-1, CAMPAIGN-LIVE-WRITE-1, STEP2-RC-RERUN-1, RELEASE-PRODUCER-1, S5-01 folded into P2CG2 as a registration correction; LSC-SALVAGE-1 conditional on decision 3. Everything else is disclosed as known issues and worked after v2.2.0.
decisions.2: F1 display half (HOST badge): "Reword Step 2's claim to 'no implied server authority' and list the HOST badge as a known issue (recommended by 2 of 3 proposers)".
decisions.3: Salvage: "Run one co-op host repro now (read-only scratch test); promote LSC-SALVAGE-1 into the release-blocking set only if the next save actually breaks (recommended by 2 of 3)".
decisions.4: Budgets: "Step 4: 16 -> 29 (+3 if salvage is promoted, +2-3 per pre-named split); Step 7: 1 -> 3; Step 5: 4 -> 7 (recommended)".
decisions.5: Step 2 evidence binding: "Keep the rcSha binding: LSC-2P proves the current build now, and STEP2-RC-RERUN-1 reruns Step 2 on the release-candidate build so its record binds the real RC. Step 3 starts once LSC-2P closes, not once Step 2 is marked complete (recommended)".
decisions.6: Host in a new window/tab (owner, verbatim): "We should be able to open multiple windows and have the same state registered and available at all times to interact with different sections if needed. Not blocking". Root reading: the target behaviour is multi-window shared state and authority for the same identity; it is not release-blocking. For v2.2.0, CAMPAIGN-LIVE-WRITE-1 must not preclude it: a save from a window without the session token is refused with a clear reason on the save card, unsaved changes are kept, and the limitation is disclosed. A post-v2.2.0 follow-up unit (MULTI-WINDOW-SESSION-1) is registered for multi-window shared campaign state and host authority across windows of the same profile.
decisions.7: RELEASE-PRODUCER-1 placement: "Step 7, first position, before the release-candidate freeze (recommended by 2 of 3)".
decisions.8: Desktop/origin design choices: "Take all the recommended defaults in the README (recommended)" (E:/Projects/Personal/MekStation-wt/_reports/2026-10-24/reg-desktop-origin/README.md section 5).

Live host, PUT with a host-shaped body.coopSession and no bearer: 403 with a typed code (today 200, F1 row); record version unchanged, live host untouched, nothing broadcast.
Host, same tab, reload while live: bearer still in sessionStorage, PUT 200.
Host, new window without the token while live: PUT refused with the typed reason; the save card shows it; the dirty flag and unsaved changes are kept (not labelled "kept locally"); disclosed.
App restart, no member reconnected (no live entry): offline path, accepted, pinned. App restart after a guest reconnected (live entry again): refused as in the new-window row.
Host token expired, same tab: refresh path then 200, or a typed re-unlock refusal; never "kept locally".
Guest profile, host offline (no live entry): PUT and DELETE accepted, pinned as disclosed behaviour.
Anonymous DELETE while a host is live: refused. Guest mirror save of its own record: unchanged (pinned before the change).
